name: What happens if custom cabinets arrive late during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What happens if custom cabinets arrive late during a kitchen remodel?
mainEntity.text: What happens if custom cabinets arrive late during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: If custom cabinets arrive late, the kitchen remodel can slow down significantly because many later tasks depend on cabinet installation. Countertop templating usually happens after cabinets are set, and finish plumbing, electrical trim, and final detailing often cannot proceed until the cabinetry is in place. A good contractor may be able to resequence some work, such as flooring touch-ups, painting, or backsplash prep, but some delays are unavoidable. Late cabinet deliveries are one of the most common causes of schedule drift in full kitchen renovations. Homeowners should confirm lead times in writing, ask when orders will actually be placed, and understand whether the contractor has backup plans if a finish or dimension is backordered. The best way to reduce this risk is to finalize cabinet selections early and avoid changes after ordering begins.
